ExperimentRun.title: ExperimentRun
ExperimentRun.description: Recorded solver run with parameter configuration, runtime, solutions, and variance metrics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the experiment run.

name.description: User label or auto-generated name for this benchmark run.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the run was recorded.

config.description: Solver configuration used for this run.

floorRates.description: Floor rates mapping used for this run.

activeShopsCount.description: Number of active shops included in this solve.

totalArea.description: Total area across all active shops.

totalValue.description: Total valuation across all active shops.

summary.description: Top solution summary metrics including objective variance and aggregate deltas.

solutions.description: All generated bucket allocations and metrics.

/experiments/{experimentId}.description: Saved solver benchmark experiments and test runs.
